name: Hidden
description:
You are using the environment, terrain, and even other combatants to mask your presence. Creatures searching for you make an opposed Mind (Perception) check against your Body (Stealth); otherwise you must beat their Awareness.

You give away your position if you make too much noise. When you attack a creature that is aware of you but cannot see you, you have Advantage; against a creature completely unaware of you, you have Greater Advantage.
